sources.title: H Company Releases Holo4 Open Computer-Use Weights on Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Holo4-27B is published on Hugging Face as Hcompany/Holo4-27B, a Qwen3.8-27B-based vision-language computer-use model under the CC BY-NC 4.0 license.

sources.title: H Company Ships Holo4, Open-Weight Agents That Work Any Software ...
sources.snippet: H company published details of Holo4, a new series of agentic models built to operate software through whichever interface is available: graphical interfaces, written code, MCP, or direct API calls.

sources.title: Holo4 Computer-Use AI: Run GUI Agents Locally on Windows, Benchmarks ...
sources.snippet: H Company released Holo4 computer-use models in 27B and 35B-A3B sizes with downloadable weights, but Holo4-27B is listed under a noncommercial license.

sources.title: abenzerps/Holo4-27B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GGUF quantizations of Hcompany/Holo4-27B, a 27B dense vision-language model (VLM) for Computer Use, tool-driven work, and agentic workflows.

sources.title: H Company's Holo4 Handles Screens, Code, and APIs With 79% Fewer ...
sources.snippet: Holo4 27B scores 61.7% on OSWorld 2.0 vs 81.8% for Opus 5.5, at far lower cost. Trained via SFT plus RL on ~10,000 synthetic tasks from H's Agentic Task Factory. Weights available on Hugging Face in BF16, FP8, NVFP4, and 4-bit GGUF.
